A made-up list in the shape of the game's hotfix article, written for these tests.

November 11, 2026

Classes

  • Druid
    • Feral
      • Pounce now leaves its bleed on targets that are already bleeding.
  • Hunter
    • Volley no longer keeps channelling after the Hunter starts moving.

Items

  • The Tailor's Travel Kit can be traded again.

November 10, 2026

Classes

  • Druid
    • Moonfire costs 10% less mana.
  • Shaman
    • Enhancement
      • Stormstrike damage reduced to 90% weapon damage (was 120%), and its cooldown is now 10 seconds (was 8 seconds).

Professions

  • Journeyman Campfire Kit can now be placed with Cooking 90, the skill its recipe asks for (was Cooking 140).

Quests

  • Murloc Tideskimmers drop Saltwater Murloc Eyes for the quest "A Taste of the Sea" again.

November 9, 2026

Dungeons

  • Enemies in dungeons now award 50% more experience.
